Two years ago, I left my "dream job." I thought it was a dream job, but it turned out to be a complete failure. I told myself I was done working in the tech industry. I tried to find something else, and after a year, I realized how difficult it was to start doing what I wanted (a sports-related business). I also realized how much I missed IT and teamwork. Since then, I've been looking for a new IT job, taking my time and accepting job offers on LinkedIn. However, 99% of these offers are bullshit—fake offers, stalled projects, unstarted projects, and so on. Maybe it's silly and the same old story, but the "money, money, money..." attitude is killing this industry, this industry, and others. People hate their bullshit jobs because they see that the company's only goal is to make money, and the company's mission or product vision are just empty words.
